descripcion: Pantalla dividida en vertical, mitad y mitad. Izquierda: el «antes», el estado del problema con tonos apagados, fríos y desaturados. Derecha: el «después», el mismo sujeto con el mismo encuadre ya resuelto, con luz cálida, colores de marca y el producto presente. Una banda superior lleva el titular, cada mitad tiene una etiqueta pequeña tipo píldora y una flecha circular sobre la línea central une los dos estados.
reference_style: Side-by-side before/after split-screen ad with a strongly contrasting color grade between the two halves and a compact headline band on top

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The contrast between the muted left half and the bright right half. 2) The headline in the top band. 3) The product inside the 'after' half. 4) The small 'before' and 'after' labels and the central arrow badge.
art_direction.composition_style: A solid headline band across the full width of the top 16-18% of the canvas. Below it, the remaining 82-84% is split vertically exactly in half by a thin divider: left half = before, right half = after. Both halves use the same camera angle, framing and subject scale so they read as a mirrored pair where only the state changes.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline band: full width, 16-18% of the canvas height, text centered with 6% side margins. Split area: two equal halves of 50% width each, separated by a light divider line about 0.5-0.7% of the canvas wide. Labels sit about 3% below the band and 4% in from the left edge of each half. The arrow badge is centered on the divider at the vertical middle of the split area (about 58-60% from the top). Keep the bottom 6% free of text.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Before half: flat, cool, slightly underexposed light, saturation reduced by about 50%, grey-blue cast, no glow. After half: soft warm key light from the upper right, full saturation, a gentle glow and brand-colored tones in the background or props, crisp product highlights. Same lens and moderate shallow depth of field on both halves.

layout_summary: Square canvas. Top band (16-18% of the height) in a solid brand color holding a centered 1-2 line headline. Below, a vertical 50/50 split: the left half shows the subject in its problem state (muted, cool, desaturated) with a small 'before' pill label at its top-left; the right half shows the same subject, same framing, in the solved state (warm, bright, brand colors) with a small 'after' pill label at its top-left and the user's product visible in its lower-right area. A thin light divider separates the halves and a small circular badge with a right-pointing arrow sits on the divider at mid-height.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Full width, top 16-18% of the canvas
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Solid color strip that holds the headline and frames the comparison below
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Fill with the darkest or primary color of the approved palette, flat, no texture or gradient.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left 50% of the split area, from the bottom of the headline band to the bottom of the canvas
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the problem state the viewer instantly recognizes as their own
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Show the subject of the transformation in its problem state, chosen to fit the product: a body area, hair or skin for beauty products; a room, surface or object for home products; an outfit or fit for clothing; a device setup or task for gadgets; a tired or stressed everyday moment for supplements or services. Show the situation, the person or the visible surface. Realistic and relatable, never exaggerated or grotesque. Muted, cool, desaturated grade. The product must NOT appear in this half.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right 50% of the split area, from the bottom of the headline band to the bottom of the canvas
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the solved state and ties it to the product and the brand colors
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Same subject, same camera angle, framing and scale as the before half, now in the solved state with a believable, realistic improvement. Warm, bright grade with brand-colored tones in the background or props.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Inside the after half, lower-right area, about 28-34% of the canvas height and no wider than about 30% of the canvas width, kept clear of the divider, the arrow badge and the label
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Credits the transformation to the product
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, packaging, label and colors), naturally integrated in the scene (held in hand, standing on the surface or being used), front or 3/4 view, sharply in focus.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Vertical divider at exactly 50% of the canvas width across the split area; circular badge centered on it at about 58-60% from the top, diameter about 9-10% of the canvas
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Separates the two states and signals the direction of change
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Thin light line in white or the lightest palette color. Badge filled with the brand accent, holding a simple white right-pointing arrow or chevron, with a soft drop shadow.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top-left corner of each half, about 3% below the headline band and 4% in from that half's left edge
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Names each state at a glance
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small rounded pills sized to their text: the before pill in neutral dark grey with white text; the after pill in the brand accent with white or dark text, whichever contrasts more.

text_layers.reference_position: Centered inside the top headline band
text_layers.text_style: Extra bold sans-serif, each line about 5.5-6.5% of the canvas height, max 2 lines, centered, white or the highest-contrast color on the band; one key word may use the brand accent
text_layers.guia_texto: Nombra la transformación en 4 a 9 palabras según el ángulo: el cambio logrado, el tiempo que tomó o el dolor que desapareció.

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the pill at the top-left of the left half
text_layers.text_style: Bold uppercase sans-serif, about 2.8-3.2% of the canvas height, 1 line, white on the neutral grey pill
text_layers.guia_texto: 1 o 2 palabras que marquen el estado inicial: «Antes» o un punto de partida como «Día 1».

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the pill at the top-left of the right half
text_layers.text_style: Bold uppercase sans-serif, about 2.8-3.2% of the canvas height, 1 line, high contrast on the accent pill
text_layers.guia_texto: 1 o 2 palabras que marquen el estado final: «Después» o el tiempo del resultado como «Día 30», siempre coherente con la etiqueta del antes.

mandatory_visual_elements: Vertical 50/50 split with a thin light divider
Before half muted, cool and desaturated, without the product
After half warm, bright and in brand colors, with the user's product visible
Same subject, camera angle and framing in both halves
Small pill label at the top-left of each half
Circular arrow badge centered on the divider
Solid headline band across the top
forbidden_additions: Price, discount, offer or urgency badge
Trust seals, guarantee or certification badges
Extra text inside the photos beyond the two labels
More than two panels or a horizontal (top/bottom) split
notas_paleta: La paleta de marca vive solo en la mitad del «después», en la banda del titular y en los acentos (píldora del después y flecha). La mitad del «antes» queda fuera de la paleta a propósito: grises fríos y desaturados, para que el contraste de color cuente la historia.
